summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of HookForge V1 - TikTok Hook Analyzer. Tested all backend APIs (11 endpoints), frontend UI flows (30 test cases), and integration between frontend and backend. All core features working correctly: niche feed with real TikTok data, hook analysis pipeline (yt-dlp + ffmpeg + Gemini vision LLM), customization workflow, and history. App correctly opens directly to Niche Feed with no auth/landing page. All data-testid attributes present and functional.

backend_issues.notes: POST /api/videos/{id}/customize requires a real photo with a recognizable face (AI model validation) - this is expected behavior, not a bug. The endpoint works correctly when provided with valid input.
